title: Array Methods
description: Test your understanding of built-in JavaScript array methods and their uses.

quiz.question: Which array method creates a new array with the results of calling a function on every element?
quiz.explanation: `map()` returns a new array with the results of the function applied to each element.

quiz.question: What does `filter()` do in JavaScript?
options: Returns a new array with elements that pass a test
quiz.correctAnswer: Returns a new array with elements that pass a test
quiz.explanation: `filter()` creates a new array containing elements that meet the condition.

quiz.question: Which method executes a provided function once for each array element but does not return a new array?
quiz.explanation: `forEach()` performs operations on each element but doesn’t return anything.

quiz.question: Which method combines all elements of an array into a single value?
quiz.explanation: `reduce()` takes a callback and returns a single value by combining array elements.

quiz.question: What is the output of `[1,2,3].includes(2)`?
quiz.explanation: `includes()` checks if a value is present in the array and returns `true` or `false`.

quiz.question: Which method returns the index of the first element that matches a condition?
quiz.explanation: `findIndex()` returns the index of the first element that satisfies the condition.

quiz.question: What does `some()` return?
options: true if at least one element meets the condition
The first element in the array
quiz.correctAnswer: true if at least one element meets the condition
quiz.explanation: `some()` returns `true` if at least one array element passes the test.

quiz.question: Which method checks that **all** elements in an array pass a test?
quiz.explanation: `every()` checks if all elements satisfy the condition and returns a boolean.

quiz.question: What does `Array.from('abc')` return?
quiz.explanation: `Array.from()` converts a string into an array of characters.

quiz.question: Which method merges two or more arrays?
quiz.explanation: `concat()` merges two or more arrays into a single array.
